recipes.name: Minestrone soup
ingredients: 6 cups (1.4 liters) vegetable or chicken broth
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) cannellini or kidney beans, drained
3/4 cup (85 g) small pasta like ditalini
2 cups (60 g) spinach or chopped kale
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 6 to 8 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic and zucchini and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, broth and seasoning and bring to a boil.
Turn the heat down and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the beans and pasta and simmer for 9 to 10 minutes, until the pasta is tender.
Stir in the spinach for 1 minute, add salt to taste, and serve with parmesan.

recipes.name: French onion soup
ingredients: 4 large yellow onions (about 3 lb / 1.4 kg), thinly sliced
1 teaspoon fresh thyme or 1/2 teaspoon dried
1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar or Worcestershire sauce
2 cups (200 g) grated Gruyere or Swiss cheese
steps: Slice the onions thinly. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a big pot over medium heat and add the onions, salt and sugar.
Cook for 45 to 60 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until the onions are deep brown and jammy. Turn the heat down if they start to burn.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Add the broth, thyme, bay leaf and vinegar and simmer for 20 minutes. Take out the bay leaf.
Heat the broiler. Ladle the soup into oven-safe bowls on a baking sheet.
Float 2 toasts on each bowl and cover with cheese.
Broil for 2 to 3 minutes, until bubbly and browned. An adult should move the hot bowls.

recipes.name: Split pea soup with ham
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) dried green split peas, rinsed
8 cups (2 liters) chicken broth or water
1 meaty ham bone or 2 cups (300 g) diced ham
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the split peas, broth, ham bone, bay leaf and thyme and bring to a boil.
Turn the heat to low, cover partly and simmer for 1 hour to 1 hour 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until the peas break down.
Take out the ham bone and bay leaf. Pull the meat off the bone, chop it and stir it back in.
Season with salt and pepper. Add water if it's too thick.

recipes.name: Hearty lentil soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (300 g) brown or green lentils, rinsed
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 7 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and broth and bring to a boil.
Turn the heat down and simmer for 30 to 35 minutes, until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the spinach, lemon juice and salt. Cook for 1 minute more.

recipes.name: Black bean soup
ingredients: 3 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) black beans, with their liquid
4 cups (960 ml) vegetable or chicken broth
Sour cream, avocado and cilantro to serve
steps: Chop the onion, pepper and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion and pepper for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin and oregano and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beans with their liquid, broth and salt and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Blend about half the soup with a stick blender, leaving some beans whole.
Stir in the lime juice and serve with sour cream, avocado and cilantro.

recipes.name: Butternut squash soup
ingredients: 1 butternut squash (about 3 lb / 1.4 kg), peeled and cubed
4 cups (960 ml) vegetable or chicken broth
1/2 cup (120 ml) cream or coconut milk
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Peel and cube the squash, onion and apple. An adult should do the squash, it's hard to cut.
Toss them with the oil, salt, pepper and cinnamon on a big sheet pan.
Roast for 35 to 40 minutes, until soft and browned at the edges.
Put everything in a big pot with the broth and bring to a simmer.
Blend with a stick blender until smooth.
Stir in the cream and add more salt to taste.

recipes.name: Potato leek soup
ingredients: 3 leeks, white and light green parts, sliced and washed well
2 lb (900 g) Yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cubed
6 cups (1.4 liters) chicken or vegetable broth
1/2 cup (120 ml) heavy cream or milk
steps: Slice the leeks, then swish them in a bowl of water to wash off grit. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a big pot over medium-low heat and cook the leeks for 8 to 10 minutes, until soft but not brown.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, broth, bay leaf and salt and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 minutes, until the potatoes are very soft.
Take out the bay leaf and blend until smooth.
Stir in the cream and top with chives. Serve hot, or chilled for vichyssoise.

recipes.name: Loaded baked potato soup
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb (1.1 kg) russet potatoes, peeled and cubed
steps: Chop the bacon, onion and potatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the bacon in a big pot over medium heat for 8 minutes, until crisp. Lift it out and leave 2 tablespoons of fat.
Cook the onion in the fat for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the broth and milk.
Add the potatoes, salt and pepper and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until tender. Don't let it boil hard.
Mash some of the potatoes in the pot to thicken it.
Stir in 1 cup of the cheese and the sour cream.
Top with bacon, the rest of the cheese and green onions.

recipes.name: Broccoli cheddar soup
ingredients: 2 cups (480 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
steps: Chop the onion and broccoli and grate the carrot. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the milk and broth.
Add the broccoli, carrot, salt, pepper and nutmeg and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the broccoli is tender.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the cheese a handful at a time until melted.
Blend a little with a stick blender if you like it smoother. Serve in bread bowls for fun.

recipes.name: Cream of mushroom soup
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fresh thyme or 1/2 teaspoon dried
4 cups (960 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
steps: Chop the onion and slice the mushrooms. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a big pot over medium-high heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, until their liquid is gone and they brown.
Add the garlic and thyme and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then slowly add the broth.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend half the soup, or all of it for smooth soup, then stir in the cream, salt and pepper.

recipes.name: New England clam chowder
ingredients: 2 bottles (8 oz / 240 ml each) clam juice
1 1/2 lb (680 g) Yukon gold potatoes, cut in 1/2 inch cubes
3 cans (6.5 oz / 185 g each) chopped clams, with their juice
steps: Chop the bacon, onion, celery and potatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the bacon in a big pot over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, until crisp.
Add the onion and celery and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the clam juice and milk.
Add the potatoes, bay leaf and thyme and simmer for 15 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
Add the clams with their juice and the cream and heat for 5 minutes. Don't let it boil.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with oyster crackers.

recipes.name: Corn chowder
ingredients: 3 cups (720 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
1 lb (450 g) potatoes, cut in small cubes
4 cups (600 g) corn kernels, fresh or frozen
steps: Chop the bacon and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the bacon in a big pot over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, until crisp. Lift it out.
Cook the onion and pepper in the fat for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then add the broth.
Add the potatoes and simmer for 12 minutes.
Add the corn, milk, cream, salt and paprika and simmer for 8 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
Blend about a third of the soup to thicken it and top with the bacon.

recipes.name: Classic vegetable soup
ingredients: 1 cup (120 g) green beans, cut in pieces
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 7 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, tomatoes, broth, thyme and bay leaf and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the green beans, corn and peas and simmer for 10 minutes more, until everything is tender.
Take out the bay leaf and season with salt.

recipes.name: Beef and barley soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) beef chuck, cut in 3/4 inch cubes
steps: Cut the beef and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Season the beef with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in 2 batches for 5 minutes each. Lift it out.
Turn the heat to medium and cook the onion, carrots, celery and mushrooms for 7 minutes.
Add the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef, broth, thyme and bay leaves and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 45 minutes.
Add the barley and simmer for 40 to 45 minutes more, until the beef and barley are tender. Take out the bay leaves.

recipes.name: Chicken tortilla soup
ingredients: 1 can (14.5 oz / 410 g) fire-roasted diced tomatoes
1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) black beans, drained
Tortilla chips, avocado, shredded cheese, sour cream and cilantro
steps: Chop the onion, jalapeno and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion and jalapeno for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, chili powder and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth and whole chicken breasts and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C) inside.
Lift out the chicken, shred it with two forks and put it back.
Add the beans, corn and salt and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in the juice of the lime.
Serve with crushed chips, avocado, cheese, sour cream and cilantro.

recipes.name: Pozole rojo
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb (1.1 kg) boneless pork shoulder, cut in 2 inch chunks
2 cans (25 oz / 700 g each) white hominy, drained and rinsed
Shredded cabbage, sliced radishes, chopped onion, lime wedges and tostadas to serve
steps: Put the pork, onion halves, 4 garlic cloves, bay leaves, salt and water in a big pot and bring to a boil. Skim off the foam.
Cover partly and simmer for 1 hour 30 minutes, until the pork is very tender.
Meanwhile, pull the stems and seeds out of the chilies. Ask an adult to help.
Soak the chilies in 2 cups of hot water for 20 minutes, until soft.
Blend the chilies, 1 1/2 cups of their soaking water, the rest of the garlic, oregano and cumin until very smooth.
Pour the chili sauce through a strainer into the pot. Take out the onion and bay leaves.
Add the hominy and simmer for 30 minutes. Shred the pork a little with a spoon and add salt to taste.
Serve with cabbage, radishes, onion, lime and tostadas on the side.

recipes.name: Sopa de fideo
ingredients: 7 oz (200 g) fideo noodles or thin spaghetti broken into 1 inch pieces
2 tomatoes or 1 can (14.5 oz / 410 g) diced tomatoes
Lime wedges and crumbled queso fresco to serve
steps: Blend the tomatoes, onion and garlic with 1 cup of the broth until smooth.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat.
Add the noodles and stir for 3 to 4 minutes, until golden brown. Watch closely so they don't burn.
Carefully pour in the tomato mix. It will sizzle and splatter, so ask an adult to help.
Add the rest of the broth, salt and cilantro and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 8 to 10 minutes, until the noodles are tender.
Serve with lime and queso fresco.

recipes.name: Albondigas meatball soup
ingredients: 1/3 cup (65 g) uncooked long grain rice
1 teaspoon salt, plus more to taste
steps: Mix the beef, rice, egg, mint, salt and cumin. Roll into 1 inch balls and wash your hands.
Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Blend the tomatoes until smooth and add them with the broth. Bring to a boil.
Gently drop in the meatballs, carrots and potato.
Simmer for 25 minutes, until the rice in the meatballs is tender.
Add the zucchini and simmer for 8 minutes more. Add salt to taste.

recipes.name: Caldo de pollo
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) bone-in chicken pieces like thighs and drumsticks
2 ears of corn, each cut in 3 pieces
Lime wedges, cilantro, chopped onion and warm tortillas to serve
steps: Put the chicken, water, onion, garlic and salt in a big pot and bring to a boil. Skim off the foam.
Turn the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Cut the vegetables into big chunks. Ask an adult to help.
Add the carrots, potatoes and corn and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the zucchini and cabbage and simmer for 10 minutes more, until all the vegetables are tender and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Taste and add more salt if needed.
Serve in big bowls with lime, cilantro, onion and tortillas.

recipes.name: Tomato spinach tortellini soup
ingredients: 4 cups (960 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
steps: Chop the onion and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and broth and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the tortellini and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes, until tender.
Stir in the spinach and cream until the spinach wilts.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with parmesan.

recipes.name: Italian wedding soup
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) ground beef or a mix of beef and pork
1/4 cup (25 g) grated parmesan, plus more to serve
3/4 cup (120 g) acini di pepe or orzo pasta
4 cups (120 g) chopped spinach or escarole
steps: Mix the meat, breadcrumbs, parmesan, egg, garlic and salt and roll into 3/4 inch meatballs. Wash your hands.
Chop the onion and carrots. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion and carrots for 6 minutes.
Add the broth and bring to a boil.
Gently add the meatballs and the pasta.
Simmer for 10 to 12 minutes, until the pasta is tender and the meatballs are cooked through.
Stir in the spinach for 1 to 2 minutes, until wilted. Serve with parmesan.

recipes.name: Pasta e fagioli
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) ground beef or Italian sausage (optional)
2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) cannellini or kidney beans, drained
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the meat in the oil in a big pot over medium heat for 6 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat.
Add the onion, carrots and celery and cook for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth, seasoning and beans and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the pasta and simmer for 9 to 10 minutes, until tender. Add salt and serve with parmesan.

recipes.name: Ribollita Tuscan bread soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive oil, plus more to serve
2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) cannellini beans, drained
1 bunch lacinato kale, stems removed, chopped
4 thick slices stale crusty bread, torn
steps: Chop the vegetables and kale. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 10 minutes.
Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans, broth, kale and salt and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in the torn bread and simmer for 10 minutes, until the bread breaks down and the soup is thick.
Drizzle with olive oil and top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Zuppa Toscana
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) Italian sausage, casings removed
1 1/2 lb (680 g) russet potatoes, cut in half and thinly sliced
steps: Chop the bacon, onion and garlic and slice the potatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the sausage and bacon in a big pot over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, until browned. Drain off most of the fat.
Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, then the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the broth, water, potatoes and chili flakes and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the kale and cream and simmer for 3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Egg drop soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornstarch mixed with 3 tablespoons water
steps: Bring the broth, ginger, soy sauce, turmeric and pepper to a boil in a pot.
Stir in the cornstarch mix and simmer for 1 minute, until a little thick.
Turn the heat to low so the soup barely bubbles.
Stir the soup in a circle and slowly drizzle in the eggs in a thin stream.
Wait 10 seconds, then gently stir to make silky ribbons.
Turn off the heat and stir in the sesame oil. Top with green onions.

recipes.name: Hot and sour soup
ingredients: 4 oz (115 g) firm tofu, cut in thin strips
3 tablespoons rice vinegar or Chinese black vinegar
1/2 teaspoon white pepper, or more for extra heat
3 tablespoons cornstarch mixed with 1/4 cup (60 ml) water
steps: Slice the mushrooms, tofu and green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Bring the broth to a boil and add the mushrooms and bamboo shoots. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the tofu, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and white pepper.
Stir in the cornstarch mix and simmer for 1 to 2 minutes, until thick.
Turn the heat to low and drizzle in the eggs while stirring slowly.
Stir in the sesame oil and top with green onions. Taste and add more vinegar or pepper if you like.

recipes.name: Wonton soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon soy sauce, for the broth
steps: Chop the shrimp and green onion. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the pork, shrimp, green onion, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil and salt. Wash your hands after.
Put 1 teaspoon of filling in the middle of a wrapper and wet the edges.
Fold into a triangle, press out the air, then bring the two bottom corners together and pinch.
Bring the broth and soy sauce to a simmer in a pot.
Boil the wontons in a separate big pot of water for 4 to 5 minutes, until they float and the filling is cooked through.
Add the bok choy to the broth for 2 minutes.
Lift the wontons into bowls and ladle the broth and bok choy over them. Top with green onions.

recipes.name: Chinese chicken and sweet corn soup
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) boneless chicken breast, finely chopped
2 tablespoons cornstarch mixed with 3 tablespoons water
steps: Chop the chicken finely. Ask an adult to help, and wash your hands after.
Bring the broth, creamed corn and ginger to a boil in a pot.
Add the chicken and simmer for 5 minutes, until 165°F (74°C) and no pink is left.
Stir in the soy sauce, pepper and cornstarch mix and simmer for 1 minute, until thick.
Turn the heat to low and drizzle in the eggs while stirring slowly.
Stir in the sesame oil and top with green onion.

recipes.name: Miso soup
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dashi powder, or homemade dashi
3 tablespoons white or yellow miso paste
7 oz (200 g) silken or soft tofu, cut in small cubes
steps: Soak the wakame in a bowl of water for 5 minutes, then drain.
Bring the water and dashi powder to a simmer in a pot.
Cut the tofu and green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Put the miso in a ladle, dip it in the broth and stir with chopsticks until dissolved.
Turn the heat to low and add the tofu and wakame for 1 to 2 minutes, until hot.
Don't let it boil after adding miso. Top with green onions and serve.

recipes.name: Easy shoyu chicken ramen
ingredients: 4 green onions, whites and greens apart
1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs
4 servings fresh or dried ramen noodles
Nori sheets, corn and bamboo shoots to top
steps: Simmer the broth, garlic, ginger, green onion whites, soy sauce and mirin in a big pot for 15 minutes.
Add the chicken and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until 165°F (74°C) inside. Lift it out and slice it. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the eggs in another pot for 7 minutes, then cool in ice water and peel. Cut in half.
Strain the broth to take out the garlic and ginger, and stir in the sesame oil.
Cook the noodles as the package says and drain.
Put noodles in each bowl and ladle hot broth over them.
Top with chicken, egg halves, sliced green onion greens, nori, corn and bamboo shoots.

recipes.name: Kake udon noodle soup
ingredients: 2 packs (7 oz / 200 g each) frozen udon noodles
2 slices kamaboko fish cake or a soft boiled egg (optional)
steps: Bring the water, dashi powder, soy sauce, mirin and sugar to a simmer in a pot.
Cook the frozen udon in a separate pot of boiling water for 1 to 2 minutes, until loose and hot. Drain.
Put the noodles in 2 bowls.
Ladle the hot broth over them.
Top with green onions, fish cake or egg, and a pinch of shichimi.

recipes.name: Kimchi jjigae
ingredients: 2 cups (300 g) well-fermented kimchi, chopped, plus 1/4 cup (60 ml) kimchi juice
8 oz (225 g) pork belly or pork shoulder, thinly sliced
3 cups (720 ml) water or anchovy broth
steps: Slice the pork, onion and tofu and chop the kimchi. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium-high heat and cook the pork for 3 to 4 minutes, until browned.
Add the kimchi and onion and cook for 4 minutes.
Stir in the gochugaru, gochujang, sugar and soy sauce.
Add the kimchi juice and water and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Lay the tofu on top and simmer for 5 minutes more. Add green onions and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Doenjang jjigae
ingredients: 3 cups (720 ml) water or anchovy broth
1 small potato, cut in small cubes
1 small zucchini, cut in small cubes
steps: Cut all the vegetables and tofu. Ask an adult to help.
Bring the water to a boil in a pot and stir in the doenjang and gochujang until dissolved.
Add the potato and onion and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the zucchini, mushrooms and garlic and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the tofu and simmer for 3 minutes more.
Top with green onion and chili and serve bubbling with rice.

recipes.name: Sundubu jjigae soft tofu stew
ingredients: 4 oz (115 g) pork or a few shrimp and clams
2 cups (480 ml) water or anchovy broth
1 tube (12 oz / 340 g) extra soft tofu
steps: Chop the garlic, zucchini and green onion. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a small pot over medium-low heat and stir in the gochugaru and garlic for 30 seconds. Don't let it burn.
Add the pork and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the water and soy sauce and bring to a boil.
Squeeze or spoon in the soft tofu in big pieces, and add the zucchini and seafood.
Simmer for 5 to 6 minutes, until the meat or seafood is cooked through.
Crack the eggs on top and cook for 1 minute. Top with green onion and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Miyeok guk seaweed soup
ingredients: 6 oz (170 g) beef brisket or sirloin, thinly sliced
2 tablespoons soup soy sauce or regular soy sauce
steps: Soak the seaweed in a big bowl of water for 20 minutes. It grows a lot.
Drain, squeeze out the water and cut into bite-size pieces. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the sesame oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the beef for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the seaweed and garlic and stir for 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and water and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 minutes. Add salt to taste and serve with rice. Koreans eat this on birthdays.

recipes.name: Tteokguk rice cake soup
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) sliced oval rice cakes (tteok)
6 oz (170 g) beef brisket or sirloin, thinly sliced
8 cups (2 liters) beef broth or water
2 tablespoons soup soy sauce or regular soy sauce
steps: Soak the rice cakes in cold water for 20 minutes.
Heat the sesame oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the beef and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the broth and soy sauce and bring to a boil. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Drain the rice cakes and add them. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes, until they float and are soft.
Drizzle in the eggs while stirring gently.
Add salt to taste and top with green onions and seaweed. Koreans eat this on New Year's Day.

recipes.name: Easy beef pho
ingredients: 3 inch piece fresh ginger, cut in half lengthwise
8 oz (225 g) beef sirloin or eye of round, very thinly sliced
Bean sprouts, Thai basil, cilantro, lime wedges, hoisin and sriracha
steps: Have an adult char the onion and ginger cut side down in a dry pan over high heat for 5 minutes, until blackened in spots.
Toast the star anise, cinnamon, cloves and coriander in a dry pot for 1 to 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the broth, onion and ginger and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 45 minutes, then strain. Stir in the fish sauce and sugar.
Soak or cook the noodles as the package says and drain.
Freeze the beef for 20 minutes so it slices paper thin, then slice it. Ask an adult to help.
Put noodles and raw beef slices in bowls and ladle boiling broth over them. The broth cooks the beef in about 1 minute. If you prefer, cook the beef in the broth for 1 minute first.
Top with sprouts, herbs and lime, and add hoisin and sriracha to taste.

recipes.name: Chicken pho
ingredients: 3 inch piece fresh ginger, cut in half lengthwise
2 lb (900 g) bone-in chicken thighs or breasts
Bean sprouts, Thai basil, cilantro, sliced green onion and lime wedges
steps: Have an adult char the onion and ginger cut side down in a dry pan over high heat for 5 minutes.
Toast the star anise, cinnamon and coriander in a dry pot for 1 to 2 minutes.
Add the broth, water, onion, ginger and chicken and bring to a boil. Skim off the foam.
Simmer for 30 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C) inside.
Lift out the chicken, shred the meat and throw away the skin and bones.
Strain the broth and stir in the fish sauce and sugar.
Cook the noodles as the package says and divide between bowls with the chicken.
Ladle hot broth over and top with sprouts, herbs, green onion and lime.

recipes.name: Tom yum goong
ingredients: 2 stalks lemongrass, cut in 2 inch pieces and bashed
1 lb (450 g) shrimp, peeled and deveined
1 tablespoon nam prik pao (Thai chili paste), optional
steps: Cut and bash the lemongrass with the back of a knife. Ask an adult to help.
Bring the broth, lemongrass, galangal, lime leaves and chilies to a boil.
Simmer for 10 minutes so the flavors soak in.
Add the mushrooms and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until pink and curled.
Turn off the heat and stir in the fish sauce, chili paste and lime juice. Taste and adjust.
Top with cilantro. Don't eat the lemongrass, galangal or lime leaves.

recipes.name: Tom kha gai coconut chicken soup
ingredients: 2 cans (13.5 oz / 400 ml each) coconut milk
2 stalks lemongrass, cut in 2 inch pieces and bashed
1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken breast, thinly sliced
Cilantro and sliced chilies to serve
steps: Slice the chicken and mushrooms and bash the lemongrass. Ask an adult to help.
Bring the coconut milk, broth, lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves to a gentle simmer.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the chicken and mushrooms and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Turn off the heat and stir in the fish sauce, sugar and lime juice.
Top with cilantro and chilies. Leave the lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves in the bowl.

recipes.name: Khao soi curry noodle soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons red or yellow curry paste
2 cans (13.5 oz / 400 ml each) coconut milk
1 1/2 lb (680 g) bone-in chicken drumsticks or boneless thighs
Lime wedges, sliced shallots, cilantro and pickled mustard greens
steps: Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and stir in the curry paste and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add 1 can of coconut milk and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the rest of the coconut milk, broth and chicken and bring to a simmer.
Simmer for 25 to 30 minutes, until the chicken is tender and 165°F (74°C).
Stir in the fish sauce and sugar.
Boil 3/4 of the noodles as the package says. An adult can fry the rest in hot oil for 1 minute to make a crispy topping.
Divide the boiled noodles and chicken between bowls and ladle the curry over.
Top with crispy noodles, shallots, cilantro and lime.

recipes.name: Mulligatawny soup
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs
Cooked rice and cilantro to serve
steps: Chop the vegetables and apple. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots, celery and apple for 7 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, broth and whole chicken thighs and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C) and the lentils are soft.
Lift out the chicken and shred it.
Blend the soup until mostly smooth, then add the chicken, coconut milk, salt and lemon juice.
Heat for 3 minutes and serve over a spoonful of rice with cilantro.

recipes.name: Turkish red lentil soup
ingredients: 7 cups (1.7 liters) vegetable or chicken broth
1 tablespoon butter and 1 teaspoon paprika or chili flakes, for the topping
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion and carrot for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, tomato paste, cumin and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, broth and salt and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, until the lentils fall apart.
Blend until smooth.
Melt the butter with the paprika for 30 seconds and drizzle it over each bowl. Squeeze in lemon.
